storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Rose's spike pierces the poetry page, leaving transparent bloodstains. The scent of alcohol fills the air, and colorless flames spread everywhere.

In that blaze, Horla holds the last poem, silently marking the end of the concealed genius poet's path.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
At the beginning of A.F. 3@2, during the renovation of the city named Cité, an anomaly was discovered in a fire-damaged garden: ashes climbed the burnt walls of the greenhouse like vines, and the ash roses blooming on the vines shimmered with a metallic hue.

Following the trail of the vines, an investigator from Mythag University retrieved this Silver. The moment she touched the silver powder, her fingertips were scorched black without any pain, but tears inexplicably rolled down her cheeks.

The weeping came without reason and dissipated into the ashes in an instant.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
It seems that Horla possesses a peculiar magic, drawing teachers and students who yearn for poetry and beauty to her side involuntarily.

Horla doesn't like to publish her poems, but the students of Mythag still manage to catch glimpses of her verses. The lines flowing from her pen often sweep across the campus in no time.

As the morning dew rises, someone softly recites her lines under the bell tower; at dusk, Nymphaea sits on a bench in Myda Square, flipping through her collection; after nightfall, students gather in the auditorium to rehearse the chapters she wrote.

However, even when graciously invited, Horla rarely pays attention to these activities, let alone participate in them personally. The mournful tone of those words and tearful occasions often leave her feeling lost.

"Have I spread new sorrow again?"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
This is a city of flowers and poetry, where a lingering love poem is equivalent to a freshly cut rose and can be exchanged for a week's food for a family of three. The emergence of a masterpiece also signifies that a talented poet will rise to fame.

That person used to be a gardener who spent her days with fertilizer and dead branches, relishing the flattery and admiration brought by elegant verses. She no longer tended to gardening matters, even locking the greenhouse and forbidding anyone from entering the flower room.

When asked by others, she would only reply that there was "Inspiration" hidden in the greenhouse.

They were born insignificant, the children of noble retainers. With the establishment of the Constante Federation, the old nobles were purged, and they lost their place to stay.

That was a maid who grew up accompanying the young lady but showed her talent for writing early on — but how could a servant read poetry?

Surrounded by an ever-changing environment, the talent for poetry could not provide the girl with survival capabilities. Everything made the girl even more out of place and more melancholic and sad.

Until the gardener extended her hand — that hand, cut by thorns, bestowed upon her a garden. In this tiny kingdom, they spent the happiest time of their lives.

The peaceful life began to change with a poem received from the gardener.

Her friend's talent was so moving that she wanted more people to see this poem dedicated to a friend.

The shy and melancholic friend was unwilling to sign, so the gardener signed her name in the signature place — "If published, it would also be convenient for them to send reward money."

The gardener's change also started from the first draft fee.

She could not understand why she suddenly went from protector to burden.

She could not understand why her friend could effortlessly gain all the love and praise, while her own hard work was defenseless before talent.

Blinded by desire and jealousy, she began to use her friend's trust to deceive her creations. The deceitful behavior could not be turned back. The seed was buried in the gardener's heart from the beginning, and as the reputation of the talented poet spread, it began to sprout, blooming into a bud during a street interview — the fervent fans asked the gardener questions about those secret and lingering emotions in the poems, which the gardener could not read and was soaked in sweat, hurriedly leaving the scene. Returning to the flower room late at night, faced with her friend's concerned gaze, the panicking flowers bloomed at that moment.

After a fire shocking Cité, the talented poet announced her retreat, disappearing with the wealth and fame she earned in a short time.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
"Horla, from today onward, I will treasure all your poems. In the future, I'll trade my flowers for your poems!"

"Colette, you will definitely come back to save me...right?"

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: I am Horla from Cité, and my pen name is... Ah, forgive me, I made a promise not to reveal it to anyone. My deepest apologies, but please, simply call me Horla.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: The surge of power feels like searing flames burning into my very bones.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: The roses in the courtyard are in full bloom.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: The warmth, so near...

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: When people approach me, they always recall their saddest memories and cannot help but shed tears. Can someone like me still hope to grow?

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: If you truly insist, I will step back into the sunlight... the very same sunlight as the day I left Cité...

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: With invisible ink, I sketch the deformed buds... This ghostly and ethereal rose branch truly inspires poetic verse...

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: What do you yearn for? Is it the beauty of elegant words, widespread fame, or the heartfelt sincerity woven within those words?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: <Italic:"Press closer, little Nightingale, or the Day will come before the rose is finished...">

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: I often feel as though I exist in the space between life and death. Wherever I am, melancholy spreads like a tide, and tragedies unfold, one after another. Even so, would you still wish for me to write a poem for you? Hmm... perhaps you deserve the sweetest one...

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Someone once told me that poetry is written to be appreciated... May I hear your thoughts on this?

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Have you ever felt this? Offering forgiveness for another's offense, only for the desired outcome to slip away. You extend a rose, yet your hands are left not with its lingering fragrance, but only the bloody marks of sharp thorns.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: That day, the flames of jealousy spread like a sea of blood-red roses in full bloom... All poems turned to shattered ashes amidst the crimson tongues of fire.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Forgive me, I lost myself in memories again. Please, do not look sad. It is your turn to narrate your story. Do you feel like writing a poem? Will your adventures, your experiences, your joys, your sorrows, flow like a gentle stream from your mind to your fingertips?

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: I was but a fleeting watermark on parchment, yet our encounter has caused me to linger. Perhaps this is a miracle. I will treasure this miracle and compose timeless poems for you.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Please, do not touch my neck... Just because you cannot see it does not mean it is not there.

daily.title: Chat: About Liz
daily.content: That beautiful ballerina lady... Her emerald-green flames are irresistible, even if they burn one to ashes...

daily.title: Chat: About Tinct
daily.content: If poetry exists to praise beauty, then her very existence is like poetry itself. When she begins to sing, I suddenly understand what the elders described as a nightingale's voice...

daily.title: Chat: About Nymphaea
daily.content: Every time I see Miss Nymphaea, I am reminded of that painting of water lilies. She carries the tranquil bitterness and fragrance of water lilies... I wonder what her world truly looks like?

daily.title: Chat: About Sorel
daily.content: Madam Sorel is truly beautiful. Her strength and confidence, her graceful smile in the face of fate, and her vibrant yet resolute life force—all make me envious.

daily.title: Chat: About Casiah
daily.content: I secretly watched Miss Casiah's magic show. Her performance brought such joy to the audience, but I always bring sadness... Do you think tears and smiles are equally precious? Perhaps...

daily.title: Chat: About Hanna
daily.content: P-Please, do not tell Miss Hannah that I am hiding here. I am not ready yet...

daily.title: Chat: About Colette
daily.content: Human emotions are as fragile and precious as flowers...

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Poetry, flames, and sorrow are alike; they engulf you without notice... By the time you come to your senses, you are already immersed in the world of poetry...

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: There is nothing in this world to hate. The golden years deserve praise, while the decline of old age deserves pity; the finery of youth is enviable, while tattered remnants evoke thoughtful reflection.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: My body was not affected by Dissolution; those black liquids are simply ink. But honestly, even without Dissolution, everything eventually turns into Illusion, does it not?

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Mythag's Student Poetry Club wants me to be their advisor... I cannot agree. I do not wish to dampen their spirits, but I fear I would only bring them disappointment and discouragement.

daily.title: Chat: About Ghosts
daily.content: I've always sensed the presence of "ghosts" around me, like some inexplicable possession or bewitchment, draining my hope for the world. But if it's a ghost, how do you explain the milk and water vanishing into thin air...?

daily.title: Chat: About Cité
daily.content: I almost forgot... What kind of flowers bloom in Cité this season?

daily.title: Chat: About Her Pain
daily.content: The beauty of blooming flowers is matched by the sadness of their withering. No matter how many times I feel sorrow, I cannot help but stop and mourn for them. If I were to ignore them out of fear of pain, how sad these flowers would be...

daily.title: Chat: About Her Poems
daily.content: Poetry and flowers are probably the same thing, are they not? Both are fleeting yet eternal. In this boundless world, they capture the most unforgettable moments in a small space... I think everyone has fallen silent for a poem, just as they pause to admire a flower's bloom.

daily.title: Chat: About Past Memories
daily.content: In the Keygrave, I saw your name on one of the tombstones... The memories of life were painful, but I never intended to forget them. For the Keeper, those lost memories must be equally precious, yes?

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper - 1
daily.content: Your presence has rekindled the ink in my pen, allowing it to flow once more like a gentle stream. I will continue to compose poetry for your story.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper - 2
daily.content: I wrote a new poem yesterday, but haven't shown it to anyone. It's not very good, but... {Male=Mr.,Female=Miss} Keeper, would you be willing to take a look at it?

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: This is not my preferred genre of verse, but if you insist, I shall try.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Let this victory be etched in poetry.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Rose thorns prick my fingers, their crimson flowing into poetry.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Let the poems of the past awaken the hidden garden within your heart.

traphase.content: Sure. Please sing to your heart's content. I... I am honored.

traphase.title: Chat: About Corposant
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: The brave navigator who dares to face lightning head-on. I was so moved when I first heard your story that I even shed tears.

traphase.title: Chat: About Nymphaea
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Of course! I didn't know you enjoy poetry too, Miss Nymphaea. If you don't mind, I have many treasured old poetry collections we could share together.

traphase.title: Thinking
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Flowers and spring... they're topics I could never write enough about.

traphase.title: Urging
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: A good verse indeed requires careful consideration.
